titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦昭襄王五十二年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals for 255 BC: the entry of the Basic Annals of Qin under the fifty-second year of King Zhaoxiang, which records the end of Zhou a year later than the Basic Annals of Zhou.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year: the entries for Qin and Chu.
The entries of the Hereditary Houses for this year: the house of Yan, on the death of King Xiao, and the house of Zhao.
